coverage_core_definition: Coverage tracks observable retention and drift over source, style, path, content, cluster, and declared domain/capability mix axes when metadata and a deployment contract support them.

stage_boundary.stage_b: Coverage may support optional budget allocation using pre-outcome observable axes only.
stage_boundary.stage_c: Coverage may validate composition drift against a frozen deployment contract, but Utility remains separate.

utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
